english.title: Drove vehicle / rode cycle on a carriageway with a reservation against the normal direction of travel in a Mersey Tunnel
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the Mersey Tunnels, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL..),]_
(B)_[the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the Mersey Tunnels' approaches and marshalling areas, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL APPROACH OR MARSHALLING AREA..),]_
(C)_[a cyclist in the Queensway Tunnel,]_
(D)_[a cyclist on the approaches to the Queensway Tunnel,]_

while on a length of carriageway which was contiguous to a central reservation, caused the

(E)_[vehicle to be driven]_
(F)_[cycle to be ridden]_

otherwise than in such a direction that the central reservation was at all times on the right hand side of the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(s) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the driver of a vehicle within the Mersey Tunnels / approaches / marshalling areas OR
being a cyclist in the Queensway Tunnel / on the approaches to the Queensway Tunnel
while on a length of carriageway which was contiguous to a central reservation,
caused the vehicle to be driven / cycle to be ridden
otherwise than in such a direction that the central reservation
was at all times on the right hand side of the vehicle.
